description: This PHP test class `LDAPTestServiceTest` contains unit tests for the `LDAPTestService` within the OrangeHRM LDAP plugin. It tests LDAP connection scenarios including valid, anonymous, invalid credentials, invalid host, port, and encryption configurations.

classes.name: LDAPTestServiceTest
classes.description: Unit test class for LDAPTestService, verifying LDAP connection configurations and error handling.

methods.name: testConnection
methods.description: Tests a successful LDAP connection with valid admin credentials.

methods.name: testAnonymousConnection
methods.description: Tests LDAP connection failure when attempting anonymous bind, expecting a ConnectionException with message 'Inappropriate authentication'.

methods.name: testInvalidUserName
methods.description: Tests LDAP connection failure with an invalid user DN, expecting an InvalidCredentialsException.

methods.name: testInvalidUserNameSyntax
methods.description: Tests LDAP connection failure with a syntax-invalid user DN, expecting a ConnectionException.

methods.name: testInvalidPassword
methods.description: Tests LDAP connection failure with an incorrect password, expecting an InvalidCredentialsException.

methods.name: testInvalidHost
methods.description: Tests LDAP connection failure with an unreachable host, expecting a ConnectionException.

methods.name: testInvalidPort
methods.description: Tests LDAP connection failure with an incorrect port, expecting a ConnectionException.

methods.name: testEncryptionWithPort
methods.description: Tests LDAP connection with SSL encryption on an incorrect port, expecting a ConnectionException.
